scoreRationale.onboarding: Migration help can be useful, but manual verification and device or network checks add real first-use friction, supporting 6.8.
scoreRationale.product: Calls, texts, WhatsApp, migration tools, and an AI voice agent give teams broad coverage, while session limits can interrupt remote work, supporting 7.5.
scoreRationale.support: One number-porting account praised responsive guidance, while device and verification cases show slower or incomplete resolution, supporting 6.7.
scoreRationale.billing: Reported charges for toll-free and forwarded calls weaken the clarity of unlimited plan language, supporting 6.1.
scoreRationale.overall: JustCall offers useful shared calling and messaging tools, but access controls and billing exceptions require a careful trial, supporting 6.8.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Conflicting reports on support effectiveness: some users praise responsiveness while others report slow/unhelpful interactions
Unknown actual pricing structure beyond existence of pricing page
Unknown prevalence of automatic logout behavior across user base
